id.description: One word: the quest's name inside the game; it must equal the file name without .json

title.description: The name shown in the journal and the tracker

giver.description: Who hands the quest out: a person id, role:<role>, or none to start by itself

requires.description: Conditions in the rule language that must all hold before the quest can start

start.description: The id of the first step

steps.description: The steps of the quest, one entry per step id

text.description: What the tracker shows while this step is active
text.example: Gather one berry from a bush.

objective.description: What finishes the step: talk, goto, gather, give, craft, interact, defeat, wait or flag, with its words

marker.description: Where the map pin points: tag:<tag>, object:<id>, npc:<id> or place:<name>

hint.description: A hint shown when the player makes no progress for a while

after.description: How long without progress before the hint shows

text.example: Berry bushes are the small green plants near the camp.

next.description: The step that follows, or END

branches.description: Conditions that send the quest to another step instead of next; the first true one wins

to.description: The step to go to, or END

fail.description: Conditions that fail the quest for good when any of them holds

rewards.description: Effect lines run when the quest ends well

journal.description: The line the journal shows for a finished quest
journal.example: The elder taught me the first things a clan needs.

offer.description: What the giver says when offering the quest

turnIn.description: What the giver says when the quest is handed in
